name: Rocca di Papa (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rocca di Papa (a white tower between the letters R and P on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Rocca di Papa, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Rocca di Papa arms — white tower between the letters R and P on red, crowned, within branches
